notes: Each JSON compares identical workloads and distance kernels within that process.
Transactional build cases independently construct LMDB and native graphs and report each measured recall.

native-materialized cases copy exactly the native topology into LMDB in bounded batches inside one parent transaction, then fully validate it. These are query-only fixtures; materialization times are not transactional construction performance.
All queries run on warm data in one read snapshot with operation-local caches, one thread, 200 queries, 16 warmups, seed 12345.
Common efSearch 64 is not a matched-recall comparison when algorithms or topology differ. ACORN includes 10 predicate-matching seeds.
The benchmark does not measure cold storage, customer embedding distributions, concurrent writers/readers, long-term tombstone accumulation, or peak process memory.
All 90 regression tests passed Release and ASAN/UBSAN, and relocated static/shared package consumers passed. Local sanitizers cover extension, storage, and tests; upstream core is prebuilt.

After timing binaries were frozen, the final commit added administrative-only validate_storage block-count checks and two regressions. Query and construction paths are unchanged; the working-tree hashes identify files at recording time, not necessarily generic compiled inputs; executable hashes below identify the retained timed binaries. Final remote CI passed all 92 tests including full-core sanitizers.

The 18 measured cases comprise 16 base cases at efSearch 64 plus two DD same-topology 1% ACORN fixtures at ef512 and 1024. At ef1024 the filtered comparator recalls are 1.0 and 0.9975; reported latency ratio remains approximately 3.28.
